title: ShareEth
tagline: Social media app to allow content creators to monetize over their work using streams of income
description:
Social media app to allow content creators to monetize over their work using streams of income. We want to make it secure and private for the content created and for the users.

We want to provide a dynamic and friendly experience for our users. Also make everything as decentralized as possible on each project iteration (currently we are thinking about making the content private with a centralized server), so that our users manage their content/data and network.
how_its_made:
It will use IPFS/Filecoin to store the content of the users. 
We use Lens for the most of the logic behind the social graph
Superfluid will manage our stream of payments
EPNS will be used for a more friendly and dynamic experience

We are working on how to make the content private and secure, we are thinking about encrypting it or using a private IPFS network
